description: SOC view of network traffic and anomaly detections stored in PostgreSQL (tables network_logs and anomalies). Read-only queries; filters use the sqlstring formatter.

options.content: **SOC · Network Anomaly Overview** — all times UTC · traffic is synthetically labeled — no live detection engine yet.

panels.title: Live status — independent of the time range
Open Incidents
panels.description: Anomalies not yet resolved (resolved IS NOT TRUE), all time. Honors the Severity and Anomaly type filters. Thresholds are heuristics (orange ≥ 10, red ≥ 50): tune them to your own baseline.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE severity::text = ANY (ARRAY[${severity:sqlstring}]::text[]))                                              AS open_total,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'high')                                  AS open_high,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (MIN(detected_at) FILTER (WHERE severity::text = ANY (ARRAY[${severity:sqlstring}]::text[])) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))::float8  AS oldest_open_s,
  COUNT(DISTINCT source_ip) FILTER (WHERE severity::text = ANY (ARRAY[${severity:sqlstring}]::text[]))                             AS open_ips
FROM anomalies
WHERE resolved IS NOT TRUE
  AND anomaly_type::text = ANY (ARRAY[${anomaly_type:sqlstring}]::text[])

panels.title: Open · High
panels.description: Unresolved high-severity anomalies, all time. Ignores the Severity filter by design (honors Anomaly type). Any value ≥ 1 is red.

panels.title: Oldest Open
panels.description: Age of the oldest unresolved anomaly (filters apply). Orange after 1 h, red after 24 h: align with your triage SLA.

panels.title: Open IPs
panels.description: Distinct source IPs behind unresolved anomalies (filters apply): candidates for blocklist review.

panels.title: Last Anomaly
panels.description: Time since the most recent detection (filters apply, all time).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM MAX(detected_at)) * 1000)::float8 AS last_anomaly_ms
FROM anomalies
WHERE severity::text = ANY (ARRAY[${severity:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND anomaly_type::text = ANY (ARRAY[${anomaly_type:sqlstring}]::text[])

panels.title: Ingestion Lag
panels.description: Age of the newest row in network_logs. If orange or red, every other panel is stale. STALE = no rows in the last 24 h. Thresholds: orange ≥ 60 s, red ≥ 300 s.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT GREATEST(0, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (MAX("timestamp") AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')))::float8 AS ingest_lag_s
FROM network_logs
WHERE "timestamp" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' > now() - interval '24 hours'

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Rows in network_logs during the selected period.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*)                                                                                 AS requests,
  ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'deny') * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2)::float8 AS blocked_pct,
  COALESCE(SUM(bytes_sent), 0)::float8                                                     AS bytes_sent
FROM network_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")

panels.title: Blocked Ratio
panels.description: Share of requests with action = 'deny'. A high value means attack pressure, not WAF failure, so no red/green judgement is applied.

panels.title: Data Sent
panels.description: Sum of bytes_sent over the period (all actions).

panels.title: Anomalies
panels.description: Detections in the selected period (filters apply).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE detected_at >= $__timeFrom())                  AS anomalies,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE detected_at < $__timeFrom()) >= 10
       THEN ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE detected_at >= $__timeFrom())
                 - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE detected_at <  $__timeFrom())) * 100.0
                 / COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE detected_at < $__timeFrom()), 0)::float8
  END                                                                   AS anomalies_delta_pct,
  COUNT(DISTINCT source_ip) FILTER (WHERE detected_at >= $__timeFrom()) AS unique_ips
FROM anomalies
WHERE detected_at >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)
  AND detected_at <= $__timeTo()
  AND severity::text = ANY (ARRAY[${severity:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND anomaly_type::text = ANY (ARRAY[${anomaly_type:sqlstring}]::text[])

panels.title: Δ vs Previous
panels.description: Change against the immediately preceding window of equal length. n/a when that window has fewer than 10 anomalies (a percentage on a tiny baseline is noise, e.g. after an ingestion gap). Large swings are normal on a system that has only run a short time or generates traffic in bursts. Orange ≥ +10 %, red ≥ +50 % (heuristic).

panels.title: Source IPs
panels.description: Distinct source IPs among detections in the period (filters apply).

panels.title: Open Incident Queue — highest severity first
panels.description: Unresolved anomalies, all time (filters apply): high severity first, then oldest first. Max 50 rows; description truncated to 200 characters. Free-text fields originate from network traffic: treat them as untrusted.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  detected_at                                       AS "Detected",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - (detected_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))::float8   AS "Age",
  split_part(source_ip::text, '/', 1)                                              AS "Source IP",
  anomaly_type                                      AS "Type",
  severity                                          AS "Severity",
  LEFT(description, 200)                            AS "Description"
FROM anomalies
WHERE resolved IS NOT TRUE
  AND severity::text = ANY (ARRAY[${severity:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND anomaly_type::text = ANY (ARRAY[${anomaly_type:sqlstring}]::text[])
ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'high' THEN 0 WHEN 'medium' THEN 1 WHEN 'low' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
         detected_at
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Traffic — Allowed vs Blocked
panels.description: Requests per time bucket (min 1 m). Blocked uses the right axis. Empty buckets are filled with 0, so an ingestion gap shows as a flat line rather than a misleading slope.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias("timestamp", $__interval, 0),
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'allow') AS "Allowed",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'deny')  AS "Blocked"
FROM network_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Anomalies over Time by Type
panels.description: Detections per time bucket, stacked by type (filters apply).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(detected_at, $__interval, 0),
  anomaly_type AS metric,
  COUNT(*)     AS count
FROM anomalies
WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at)
  AND severity::text = ANY (ARRAY[${severity:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND anomaly_type::text = ANY (ARRAY[${anomaly_type:sqlstring}]::text[])
GROUP BY 1, anomaly_type
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Anomalies by Type
panels.description: Top 10 anomaly types in the period (filters apply).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT anomaly_type AS "Type", COUNT(*) AS total
FROM anomalies
WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at)
  AND severity::text = ANY (ARRAY[${severity:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND anomaly_type::text = ANY (ARRAY[${anomaly_type:sqlstring}]::text[])
GROUP BY anomaly_type
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Severity
panels.description: Detections by severity in the period. Ignores the Severity filter (honors Anomaly type).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'high')   AS "High",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'medium') AS "Medium",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'low')    AS "Low"
FROM anomalies
WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at)
  AND anomaly_type::text = ANY (ARRAY[${anomaly_type:sqlstring}]::text[])

panels.title: Protocols
panels.description: Top 10 protocols by request count in the period.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT protocol AS "Protocol", COUNT(*) AS total
FROM network_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
GROUP BY protocol
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top Source IPs
panels.description: Top 10 source IPs by number of detections (filters apply). Behind a proxy or NAT the recorded IP may not be the real client.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT split_part(source_ip::text, '/', 1) AS "Source IP", COUNT(*) AS total
FROM anomalies
WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at)
  AND severity::text = ANY (ARRAY[${severity:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND anomaly_type::text = ANY (ARRAY[${anomaly_type:sqlstring}]::text[])
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top Blocked Ports
panels.description: Top 10 destination ports among blocked requests. Service names are hints, not fingerprints.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  t.destination_port::text
    || COALESCE(' (' || CASE t.destination_port::text
         WHEN '21' THEN 'FTP'     WHEN '22' THEN 'SSH'     WHEN '23' THEN 'Telnet'
         WHEN '25' THEN 'SMTP'    WHEN '53' THEN 'DNS'     WHEN '80' THEN 'HTTP'
         WHEN '443' THEN 'HTTPS'  WHEN '445' THEN 'SMB'    WHEN '1433' THEN 'MSSQL'
         WHEN '3306' THEN 'MySQL' WHEN '3389' THEN 'RDP'   WHEN '5432' THEN 'PG'
         WHEN '6379' THEN 'Redis' WHEN '8080' THEN 'Proxy' WHEN '8443' THEN 'TLS'
         WHEN '27017' THEN 'Mongo'
       END || ')', '') AS "Port",
  t.total
FROM (
  SELECT destination_port, COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM network_logs
  WHERE action = 'deny'
    AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
  GROUP BY destination_port
  ORDER BY total DESC
  LIMIT 10
) t
ORDER BY t.total DESC

panels.title: Anomaly Log — selected period
panels.description: Latest 200 detections in the period (filters apply), newest first. Free-text is truncated and untrusted.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  detected_at                                          AS "Detected",
  split_part(source_ip::text, '/', 1)                                                 AS "Source IP",
  anomaly_type                                         AS "Type",
  severity                                             AS "Severity",
  LEFT(description, 200)                               AS "Description",
  CASE WHEN resolved THEN 'Resolved' ELSE 'Open' END   AS "Status"
FROM anomalies
WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at)
  AND severity::text = ANY (ARRAY[${severity:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND anomaly_type::text = ANY (ARRAY[${anomaly_type:sqlstring}]::text[])
ORDER BY detected_at DESC
LIMIT 200

list.name: severity
list.label: Severity
list.definition:
SELECT initcap(severity::text) AS __text, severity::text AS __value
FROM anomalies
WHERE severity IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY severity::text
ORDER BY MIN(CASE severity::text WHEN 'high' THEN 0 WHEN 'medium' THEN 1 WHEN 'low' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END), 2
list.query:
SELECT initcap(severity::text) AS __text, severity::text AS __value
FROM anomalies
WHERE severity IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY severity::text
ORDER BY MIN(CASE severity::text WHEN 'high' THEN 0 WHEN 'medium' THEN 1 WHEN 'low' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END), 2

list.name: anomaly_type
list.label: Anomaly type
list.definition:
SELECT CASE anomaly_type::text WHEN 'ddos' THEN 'DDoS'
                               ELSE initcap(replace(anomaly_type::text, '_', ' ')) END AS __text,
       anomaly_type::text AS __value
FROM anomalies
WHERE anomaly_type IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY anomaly_type::text
ORDER BY 1
list.query:
SELECT CASE anomaly_type::text WHEN 'ddos' THEN 'DDoS'
                               ELSE initcap(replace(anomaly_type::text, '_', ' ')) END AS __text,
       anomaly_type::text AS __value
FROM anomalies
WHERE anomaly_type IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY anomaly_type::text
ORDER BY 1
